title: Spire Seer - Drafting Coach
description:
[h2]An in-game drafting coach[/h2]
Spire Seer scores your options from ~140,000 community runs of the current patch:
[list]
[*][b]Card rewards[/b] - every card on offer plus SKIP, compared with the average reward screen at the same point; once you commit to an archetype it also weighs how a card does inside that archetype.
[*][b]Shops[/b] - the best set of purchases for the gold you have, card removal included.
[*][b]Ancient / relic choices[/b] and [b]events[/b] (ranked for your current HP).
[*][b]Deck panel[/b] - archetype, themes, and warnings when you spread too thin, bloat the deck, miss AoE/draw/scaling, or are low on HP for the next elite or boss.
[/list]
Numbers are [i]lift[/i]: the win rate of runs that made that choice minus the average run at the same point. They are associations from community data, not guarantees.

[b]Controls:[/b] F9 shows/hides the panel, Shift+F9 changes the text size, drag the panel to move it.

[b]Display only[/b] - does not change gameplay, no network, no data collection.

[b]Supported game version:[/b] v0.111+ (community data from v0.111.0). Characters without data yet show "no data".
Windows. macOS / Linux / Steam Deck should work (single managed dll) but are untested - reports welcome.

Source (MIT): https://github.com/nived-k/Spire-Seer
Community data: Spire Codex (spire-codex.com), a fan-made database. Unofficial fan mod; Slay the Spire 2 (c) Mega Crit.
changeNote: Community data refreshed (v0.111.0 export of 12 Nov 2026, more runs). The Fool shows 'no data yet' until Spire Codex publishes runs for it.
